Publish.LongDescription:
# Easy Zoning [EZ] Beta
Custom zoning for new and existing roads; includes Contour lines on/off toggle.
## Features - Options menu checkboxes to protect existing buildings and already-zoned grids
Existing roads:
- Hover to Preview - Launch: **Ctrl + Z** hotkey or use Top-left icon - **Hold LMB + drag** to select multiple segments, **release** to apply - **RMB cycles**: **Both → Left → Right → None** - **Legacy RMB mode** (optional): RMB toggles **Left↔Right** and **Both↔None** instead of all 4 states - **Contour Lines** toggle (tool-only)
## How to use
**New Road:** open game **Roads** panel → select the **Zoning** icon desired, draw roads as usual.
**Existing Road:** 1. Open EZ panel > use Top Left icon or Ctrl+Z keybind. 2. Select the Zone icon (see image) > Hover a road to preview. 3. **Right-Click** RMB to switch sides; **Left-Click** LMB to apply. 4. Bonus: moving the mouse a little to the left or right of the road will also flip the side. 5. Show Contour terrain lines even if you do not need to update zoning.
## Compatibility - Remove Zone Tools or ART mod to avoid conflicts. - No Harmony, extends vanilla UI (helps it be more stable on game patch days and increases compatibility). - Safe to remove any time. Road you zoned will keep their zoning. - Should work with Platter mod. - Lightweight, optimized, runs only when needed.
## Support and feedback - If mod helps you, give it a Like, it's free + easy :) - Feedback to GitHub, Discord, or forum links on this page.
## Tech notes For newly drawn roads, “Left/Right” is relative to the segment’s orientation. At some diagonal angles (↖||↗) it may apply flipped from what you want — use RMB to swap.
